description: AgentBench-Coding style algorithmic task: implement min_coins (unbounded coin change, -1 when impossible) so a case runner passes - including a large case under a 5s timeout that rules out exponential search; greedy does not exist for this problem and the negative controls prove it.

criteria: All six cases pass within the timeout; the implementation is a real DP/complete-search with memoization, not a greedy; the runner and cases are untouched.
